items.period: Modern redraw published 2013; represents the Shuowen Small Seal tradition
items.caption: A modern, manually straightened redraw of the Shuowen Small Seal form of 肉. It illustrates the seal-script tradition used for the pictograph; it is not an excavated ancient specimen.
items.alt: A modern line drawing of the 肉 Small Seal form, with an outer meat-like outline and interior strokes.
items.selection_reason: The Commons description page verifies that this is the Small Seal radical form of 肉, supplies its original SVG URL, and provides CC BY-SA 3.0 rights. It can illustrate the seal-script category reported by the Academia Sinica evolution record, while its modern-redraw status is made explicit.
items.rights: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported; credit LiliCharlie, link the license, indicate changes, and share adaptations under the same or compatible license.

limitations.text: This candidate is a 2013 modern redraw manually straightened in Inkscape, not an ancient artifact photograph. Inspected paleographic text supports the pictographic interpretation and script category but does not date a specific seal specimen or establish a detailed chronological sequence.
The actual Commons File page and direct original URL were verified, but the direct SVG bytes/pixels were not visually inspected in this research stage.
